test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ram borrowed ₹20,000 at 6% per annum and ₹25,000 at 8% per annum, for the same duration. He had to pay ₹9,600 in all as interest. What is the time period?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal for the first loan = ₹20,000

Rate of interest for the first loan = 6% per annum

Principal for the second loan = ₹25,000

Rate of interest for the second loan = 8% per annum

Total interest = ₹9,600

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100
